idea-plugin.name: EasyFK Generator
idea-plugin.description:
EasyFK Generator

A powerful code generation plugin for the EasyFK Java/Spring Boot framework.

Features

  • Full-stack Generation — Generate complete project skeleton, Entity/Mapper, business code (Repository/Service/API/Controller/Remote), and Spring Boot AutoConfiguration in one click.
  • Incremental Generation — Add new modules or tables to existing projects without affecting current code.
  • Model Refresh — Re-generate Entity/Mapper/DTO/Param when database columns change, keeping your business logic untouched.
  • Database Import — Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle and import table structures automatically.

Supported Options

  • Project Types: Single / Microservice / Smart (multi-stack microservices)
  • Build Tools: Maven / Gradle (Groovy DSL & Kotlin DSL)
  • ORM: MyBatis / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate
  • App Types: BMS (backend management) / CLIENT (consumer-facing)
  • RPC: OpenFeign / Dubbo

简介

EasyFK 框架代码生成器 IDEA 插件，支持一键生成项目骨架、Entity/Mapper、业务代码、自动装配配置。

支持 Single / Microservice / Smart 三种项目架构，Maven / Gradle 构建，MyBatis / MyBatis-Flex / Hibernate ORM。
